h1: APT-18HSS Premium Stainless Steel Pressure Tank
bodyHtml:
APT-18HSS Premium Stainless Steel Pressure Tank

18-Liter (4.5 Gallon) 304 Stainless Steel Tank for Food Equipment, Beverages & Marine Applications | Aquasky PREMIUM-PLUS Series | Made in Taiwan

APT-18HSS is an elite-tier pressure tank constructed entirely from high-quality 304 stainless steel, engineered specifically to deliver exceptional durability and anti-rust performance in harsh environments and specialized commercial applications.

APT-18HSS has a total volume of 18 liters (4.5 gallons). The tank is designed for a robust maximum operating pressure of 10 bar (150 psi) and a maximum operating temperature of 90 °C (194 °F). To ensure highly stable and reliable system performance, it is factory pre-charged to 2 bar (30 psi) with nitrogen gas.

With a diameter of 28.0 cm (11.0 inches) and a height of 30.9 cm (12.2 inches) including its integrated base, this premium tank features a meticulously polished mirror-like surface, making it the perfect choice for demanding environments that require both peak functionality and pristine aesthetics

Price InquiryContact us

Product Overview

The APT-18HSS is an 18-liter (4.5 gallon) premium diaphragm pressure tank that represents the peak of Aquasky's engineering. Unlike standard carbon steel tanks, the PREMIUM-PLUS Series is manufactured entirely from top-grade 304 stainless steel. This ultimate anti-rust construction ensures that the APT-18HSS thrives in specialized applications and harsh environments where standard tanks would rapidly degrade, such as food processing equipment, commercial beverage dispensing, and sea water storage on yachts.

Inside the flawlessly polished mirror-finish shell, the APT-18HSS utilizes a heavy-duty butyl rubber diaphragm designed for long-lasting resilience. The superior materials guarantee that the tank remains exceptionally durable and hygienic, catering specifically to premium users who demand the highest quality and absolute reliability without compromise.

Manufactured with precision, the Aquasky PREMIUM-PLUS tanks are designed to exceed expectations in both performance and longevity, making them an indispensable asset for elite commercial, industrial, and marine systems.

Key Features & Design Advantages

  • All-304 Stainless Steel Construction provides the ultimate anti-rust protection against harsh environmental factors and corrosive elements.
  • Mirror-Polished Surface delivers a premium, easy-to-clean aesthetic ideal for sanitary environments.
  • 1" NPT Stainless Steel Connection ensures a secure, leak-free, and highly durable integration into specialized plumbing systems
  • Heavy-Duty Butyl Rubber Diaphragm designed to maintain optimal pressure levels and withstand frequent cycling
  • Factory Nitrogen Pre-charge (30 PSI) avoids the pressure loss common with standard air, guaranteeing long-term stability.
  • 100% made in Taiwan

How the PREMIUM-PLUS Pressure Tank Works

The APT-18HSS operates by storing fluid securely against the heavy-duty butyl rubber diaphragm, separated from the pre-charged nitrogen air cushion. As system pressure fluctuates, the nitrogen compresses to safely absorb and maintain pressure levels. What sets the PREMIUM-PLUS apart is its exterior resilience; the 304 stainless steel shell allows this internal mechanical process to occur flawlessly even when the tank is constantly exposed to sea spray, high humidity, or rigorous sanitary washdowns.

Key benefits

  • Thrives in harsh environments where standard carbon steel tanks would quickly rust and fail.
  • Exceptional hygiene and cleanliness, making it the perfect choice for the food and beverage industry.   
  • Unmatched aesthetic appeal for high-end installations thanks to its mirror-polished exterior.
  • Dependable, long-lasting performance engineered specifically for premium users demanding top-tier quality.

Typical Applications

  • Food processing and preparation equipment.
  • Commercial beverage dispensing systems.
  • Yacht and marine applications, including sea water storage.
  • Any premium installation requiring absolute anti-rust properties.

Frequently Asked Question (FAQ)

Q1 : I need to install a tank sideways under a low counter. What does the "H" in APT-18HSS stand for?

A: The "H" indicates that this is a Horizontal model. It features a special base that allows the 4.5-gallon (18 liters) tank to safely lay flat, making it perfect for tight vertical spaces.

Q2 : How tall is this horizontal tank when resting on its base?

A: It sits very low, with a total height (base included) of just 12.2 inches (30.9 cm).

Q3 : Does laying it horizontally reduce its structural strength or pressure rating?
A : Yes, absolutely. The 304 stainless steel construction makes the APT-18HSS highly resistant to corrosion, making it perfectly suited for storing sea water on yachts or operating in highly saline coastal environments.
